g.text: Every jumper is a straight piece cut to length (no bends). A signal that turns continues from another hole of the same 5-hole column. No wire lies on another.

g.text: (tags on the chip pins name every gate: blue NOT, grey term → segments, teal OR, red OUT; red badges mark segment output wires, resistors and display pins)

g.text: A' = NOT A: U1D pin 11 (breadboard 1) B' = NOT B: U1B pin 6 (breadboard 1) C' = NOT C: U1A pin 3 (breadboard 1)

text.style: font-size: 4.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif, 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2933

g.text: terms U1C U2A U2B U2C U2D → OR U3A U3B → OUT U3C pin 8 (breadboard 1) → R5 330Ω (breadboard 1, col 55) → display pin c
